clips.title: The story
paras: In Goldshire, Cloth and Leather Armor sends a trusted traveler east for gear. Marshal Dughan issues an armor marker redeemable with Sara Timberlain at Eastvale Logging Camp. The trip carries recruits beyond Guard Thomas's bridge to obtain armor for the realm's defense.

Guard Thomas watches Elwynn's eastern river crossing, where murlocs and gnolls threaten the border. After you carry his report to Goldshire, Marshal Dughan recognizes your service with an official Stormwind Armor Marker. Goldshire's garrison has meager stores, so Dughan gives you a marker instead of drawing equipment from them. The marker is a military voucher that records your service to the crown.

East of Guard Thomas's bridge lies Eastvale Logging Camp, Elwynn's main timber operation. Sara Timberlain works there under an official commission from the Stormwind Army to make cloth and leather gear. The kingdom's central armories are strained, leaving local artisans like Sara to outfit troops and auxiliary scouts on the frontier.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: For your shrewdness and valor, I have a marker here that is good for one piece of armor. I want you to take it to Sara Timberlain at the Eastvale Logging Camp. Give her the marker, and she will fashion the armor for you. And after you receive it, friend, use it in the defense of Elwynn.
The Eastvale Logging Camp is beyond Guard Thomas' post to the east.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I have been commissioned by the Stormwind Army to supply their people with cloth and leather armor.
If you have a marker for me, then I'd be happy to make you something.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, thank you for the marker. Please feel free to pick your choice of armor.
Luck to you, brave adventurer. And may this armor serve you well.
